conditions.quote_anchor: Step one, we're going to mark out 10:00 a.m. Eastern. So, here we are. Right here, we're about to open a new 4-hour candle at 10:00 a.m. Eastern, so I'm going to mark that out.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states step one is marking out 10:00 a.m. Eastern where the new 4-hour candle opens, exactly the condition.

conditions.quote_anchor: It's 30 minutes 30 minutes after the market opens. And if you know anything about the market open, typically that first move of the market is going to be a fakeout, which gives us plenty of time to line our bias.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote explains the 30-minutes-after-open fakeout rationale for lining up bias but never states this time defines the pattern's trading window.

conditions.quote_anchor: Go to the 15-minute time frame and look for the most recent 15-minute fair value gap that's going to be closest to price.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote directly instructs going to the 15-minute timeframe and finding the most recent FVG closest to price.

conditions.quote_anchor: I'm going to mark that out. That's where I want price to tap into.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote only says the marked level is where price should tap into; it never frames the FVG as the target of a manipulation phase.

conditions.quote_anchor: Step three is you want to see a PO3 on the 1-minute time frame tapping into that 15-minute gap.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote is the step itself: see a PO3 on the 1-minute timeframe tapping into the 15-minute gap.

conditions.quote_anchor: all it is is price moves sideways and accumulates. It then manipulates or has a fakeout and then puts in the real move to distribute.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote defines the accumulate / manipulate-fakeout / real-move sequence the condition summarizes.

conditions.quote_anchor: The second I see a candle body close through that fair value gap, I'm entering my trade.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states entry happens the second a candle body closes through the fair value gap.

conditions.quote_anchor: Now, all we need to wait for is an entry confirmation, which for me I will like to take inversion fair value gaps typically.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote requires an entry confirmation but names inversion fair value gaps, not a candle-body closure, so the mechanism drifts.

conditions.quote_anchor: The first step of this strategy is going to the 4-hour time frame and finding the most recent 4-hour candlestick that has formed and closed.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote states the first step is finding the most recent formed-and-closed 4-hour candlestick.

conditions.quote_anchor: I can very clearly see we have a 15-minute fair value gap just above price. I'm going to mark that out. That's where I want price to tap into.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote observes one gap sitting just above price on this chart rather than stating a general requirement that price be near a recent 15-minute FVG.

conditions.quote_anchor: We see a PO3 pattern straight into this 15-minute gap, right? We manipulate into that 15-minute gap.

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote narrates an observed PO3 manipulating into the 15-minute gap without stating the 1-minute timeframe or a must-form requirement.

conditions.quote_anchor: leave my stop loss at that manipulation high that we just made, the top of the 4-hour candle

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote places the stop loss at the manipulation high, the top of the 4-hour candle, exactly as the condition states.

conditions.quote_anchor: You can take the bottom of the accumulation range if you do have the risk reward

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote offers the accumulation-range bottom as an optional target conditioned on risk-reward, not as the primary target.

conditions.quote_anchor: or you can even target some liquidity lower down here or down here

adjudication_verdict.support_justification: The quote offers targeting liquidity lower down as the alternative/secondary target the condition describes.
